provenance.description: The measured resolution ladder on the synthetic positive-control fixture, at five sample sizes x three seeds x both series, for all three analysis paths. Every number in each row is the framework's own block (summary['test_resolution'] and the Deflated Sharpe / Deflated Alpha blocks it was built from), read by scripts/measure_resolution_vs_sample_size.py. This is the re-capture of the same ladder as results/resolution_floor/ladder_2500_to_50000.json, taken with the current tool so that every per-path block also carries WHAT SETS THE ALPHA FLOOR (strategy_alpha, benchmark_alphas, benchmark_alpha_std, n_benchmarks) and the framework's own per-criterion status fields (sharpe_status/sharpe_reason, alpha_status/alpha_reason). The earlier capture stays committed as the pre-driver numerical baseline: every number the two captures share is identical. The fixture is a formula, not a market: these are properties of a construction and of the decision machinery, never evidence about a security.

fixture_construction.purpose: TEST-MACHINERY CHECK ON SYNTHETIC DATA: a series produced by a known formula, used to check that the falsifiable-hypothesis machinery can return SUPPORTED. It is not evidence about any security or market.

baseline.note: The pre-driver capture of the same ladder, kept as the numerical baseline. Every number the two captures share is identical (max absolute difference 0.0 over 1,080 shared values in 90 path blocks); the re-capture adds the alpha-floor driver keys and the per-criterion status fields, and moves no number, no threshold, no bound and no verdict.
